resources.string: The radio is not in SAT RX with CAT enabled. 1) On the radio open SAT RX Bricohams. 2) Press key 8 to enable CAT. The app keeps polling and tunes by itself as soon as the radio is ready.
Enable CAT on the radio (3 steps)
1. Connect the radio over USB OTG and tap Choose device.\n2. On the radio open SAT RX Bricohams.\n3. Press key 8 (CAT enabled) and tune from here.
The radio is back in SAT RX with CAT: the tuning was applied again.
USB reconnected: opening the radio again.
Grant the location permission (precise or approximate).
Phone location is turned off. Turn it on in Settings and tap Get phone position again, or enter the coordinates manually.
Searching for a position (GPS, network and fused). %1$d s left. Keep the screen on, preferably outdoors; a cold GPS start can take minutes.
Position received: refining accuracy for %1$d more s…
No network location. Turn on Google Location Accuracy and Wi-Fi scanning in the location settings to get a quick position.
No position arrived in time. Go outdoors, check the phone location settings or enter the coordinates manually.
Source %1$s, accuracy %2$s, age %3$d s. Review and save.
Approximate permission: accuracy of several km (enough for passes, better with precise location).
Connect the radios over USB OTG. The test only reads and tunes in receive mode and restores the frequency: it does not transmit or write memory.
No USB serial adapters. Connect the radio over OTG and tap Scan.
Test finished. Share the report if you like.
The tuning renewal returned %1$s instead of RENEWED.
The radio reports PTT active during the test. The test does not transmit: check the radio.
Invalid response for %1$s or from another transfer.
pending: the radio is not in SAT RX with CAT enabled (key 8)
pending: firmware v6.0 without a physical Flash reader
no ARDF session started on the radio (pending)
Test all runs every module one after another; you can also launch them one by one. None of them transmits.

WARNING: the bridge forwards, without authentication, everything arriving over the local network to the CAT of the chosen radio. Enable it only on a trusted network and turn it off when done. It stays active only while this screen is open.
Bridge active. Connect from the PC to %1$s port %2$d (raw TCP).

In PRO mode you can write without a prior full backup. A failed or interrupted write can leave the radio unusable with no copy to recover it. For experienced users only. It turns off when you leave this screen.
PRO MODE: there is no backup of this session. If something fails you will not be able to recover the radio.
